subject: general
question: Which of the following is a major risk associated with fuel spillage?
solution:
The correct answer is __Fire hazards and environmental contamination**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fuel spillage__ poses serious risks to safety and the environment.
 
• It can lead to fire hazards due to the highly flammable nature of fuels.
 
• Environmental contamination occurs when spilled fuel seeps into soil and water sources, causing long-lasting damage.
 
• Such incidents can lead to severe ecological harm and affect local wildlife.
 
• Proper handling, storage, and disposal of fuel are essential to mitigate these risks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fire Hazards:**

 
 
• Fuel spillage increases the risk of fire outbreaks, especially in areas with sparks or open flames.
 
• It is crucial to have fire safety measures in place to prevent such incidents.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Contamination:**
 
 
• Spilled fuel contaminates the environment, affecting soil fertility and water quality.
 
• This contamination can disrupt ecosystems and harm aquatic and terrestrial life.
 
 
 
• **Preventive Measures:**
 
 
• Implementing proper storage systems and spill containment protocols is essential.
 
• Regular training and awareness programs can help mitigate risks related to fuel spillage.
